verdict.rationale: Vercel documents some control over how long runtime logs are kept: retention depends on the plan and on whether Observability Plus is enabled, and Log Drains can export logs for longer storage. That is a thin, log-only form of retention control, and nothing in the evidence covers deleting customer data. Missing for 10: user-configurable retention periods for stored data, documented data deletion or purge controls, retention coverage beyond logs, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: Retention depends on your plan and whether Observability Plus is enabled; see Runtime Logs for current limits. For longer log storage, you can use Log Drains.
